name: AbsolutePlayer
description: Play any video format — MKV, AVI, HEVC, AC-3, DTS — converted on the fly in your browser. Powered by FFmpeg compiled to WebAssembly.

content_security_policy.extension_pages: script-src 'self' 'wasm-unsafe-eval'; object-src 'self'; media-src 'self' blob: data:; img-src 'self' data:; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; connect-src *
